"""Private CPU staging for the measured confidential Flash text inputs."""

import numpy as np
import torch

from vllm.utils.torch_utils import PIN_MEMORY, async_tensor_h2d

_SUPPORTED_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZES = (4,)
_SINGLE_PARTITION = 1
_SPECULATIVE_DEPTH = 5
_MAX_CONTEXT = 1_048_576
_MAX_REQUESTS = 64
_MODEL_NAME = "deepseek-v4-1-flash"
_MIN_CUMULATIVE_ELEMENTS = 2
_ABSENT_FEATURES = (
    "pcp_manager",
    "ubatch_runner",
    "batch_sharder",
    "fast_prefill",
    "aux_output_connector",
    "pooling_runner",
    "pp_handler",
)


def supports_text_staging(runner, scheduler_output, batch, num_active_loras):
    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.ec_connector import ECConnector
    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.kv_connector import NO_OP_KV_CONNECTOR
    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.model_state import DeepseekV41ModelState
    from vllm.utils.platform_utils import is_uva_available
    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.adaptive_verification import AdaptiveVerificationManager
    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.sampler import (
        BadWordsState,
        LogitBiasState,
        PenaltiesState,
        Sampler,
    )
    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.dspark.speculator import DSparkSpeculator

    parallel, spec, state = (
        runner.parallel_config,
        runner.speculative_config,
        runner.model_state,
    )
    if not (
        all(getattr(runner, name) is None for name in _ABSENT_FEATURES)
        and not runner.lora_config
        and num_active_loras == 0
        and not runner.is_pooling_model
        and not runner.is_encoder_decoder
        and runner.is_first_pp_rank
        and runner.is_last_pp_rank
        and not runner.use_pp
        and not runner.use_dcp
        and runner.dp_size == runner.dcp_size == _SINGLE_PARTITION
        and parallel.tensor_parallel_size in _SUPPORTED_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZES
        and all(
            getattr(parallel, field) == _SINGLE_PARTITION
            for field in (
                "data_parallel_size",
                "pipeline_parallel_size",
                "prefill_context_parallel_size",
                "decode_context_parallel_size",
            )
        )
        and not parallel.enable_dbo
        and not parallel.use_ubatching
        and not parallel.enable_batch_sharded_sampling
        and not parallel.enable_expert_parallel
        and runner.scheduler_config.async_scheduling is True
        and runner.max_model_len == _MAX_CONTEXT
        and runner.max_num_reqs == _MAX_REQUESTS
        and runner.model_config.served_model_name == _MODEL_NAME
        and spec is not None
        and spec.method == "dspark"
        and spec.num_speculative_tokens == _SPECULATIVE_DEPTH
        and runner.num_speculative_steps == _SPECULATIVE_DEPTH
        and spec.num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size is None
        and (
            (spec.enable_adaptive_verification is True
             and type(runner.adaptive_verification) is AdaptiveVerificationManager)
            or (spec.enable_adaptive_verification is False
                and runner.adaptive_verification is None)
        )
        and spec.rejection_sample_method == "block"
        and spec.draft_sample_method == "probabilistic"
        and not is_uva_available()
        and not runner.model_config.logits_processors
        and type(runner.sampler) is Sampler
        and tuple(type(item) for item in runner.sampler.logits_processors)
        == (LogitBiasState, PenaltiesState, BadWordsState)
        and type(runner.speculator) is DSparkSpeculator
        and type(state) is DeepseekV41ModelState
        and runner.kv_connector is NO_OP_KV_CONNECTOR
        and type(runner.ec_connector) is ECConnector
        and runner.speculator.target_input_buffers is runner.input_buffers
        and runner.speculator.input_buffers is not runner.input_buffers
        and not runner.speculator.supports_mm_inputs
        and runner.model_config.enable_prompt_embeds is False
        and state.prompt_embeds_state is None
        and runner.uses_inputs_embeds is runner.supports_mm_inputs
        and state.supports_mm_inputs is runner.supports_mm_inputs
        and batch.num_tokens > 0
        and batch.req_ids
        and len(set(batch.req_ids)) == len(batch.req_ids)
        and set(batch.req_ids) == scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens.keys()
        and not scheduler_output.scheduled_encoder_inputs
        and all(
            not request.mm_features
            and request.prompt_embeds is None
            and request.prompt_is_token_ids is None
            for request in scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs
        )
    ):
        return False
    if runner.supports_mm_inputs:
        if not all(
            runner.encoder_cache.mm_features.get(req_id) == []
            for req_id in batch.req_ids
        ):
            return False
    elif (
        runner.encoder_cache is not None
        or getattr(state, "encoder_runner", None) is not None
    ):
        return False
    device = runner.device
    return (
        PIN_MEMORY
        and device.type == "cuda"
        and device.index is not None
        and torch.cuda.current_device() == device.index
        and torch.cuda.current_stream(device) == runner.main_stream
        and not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
    )


def private_tensor_h2d(data, device=None, dtype=None, out=None):
    expected_dtype = np.dtype(np.intp if dtype is torch.int32 else np.int32)
    minimum = 1 if dtype is torch.int32 else _MIN_CUMULATIVE_ELEMENTS
    supported = (
        PIN_MEMORY
        and type(data) is np.ndarray
        and data.ndim == 1
        and data.size >= minimum
        and data.dtype == expected_dtype
        and data.dtype.isnative
        and data.flags.c_contiguous
        and not torch.from_numpy(data).is_pinned()
        and not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
    )
    if out is not None:
        supported = supported and (
            device is None
            and dtype is None
            and type(out) is torch.Tensor
            and out.dtype is torch.int32
            and out.device.type == "cuda"
            and tuple(out.shape) == tuple(data.shape)
            and out.is_contiguous()
            and out.storage_offset() == 0
        )
    else:
        supported = supported and (
            type(device) is torch.device
            and device.type == "cuda"
            and dtype in (None, torch.int32)
        )
    if not supported:
        return async_tensor_h2d(data, device=device, dtype=dtype, out=out)

    if out is not None:
        dtype = out.dtype
    source = torch.from_numpy(data)
    # The copy owns its source; scheduler arrays can be reused after return.
    staged = torch.empty(
        source.shape, dtype=dtype or source.dtype, device="cpu", pin_memory=False
    ).copy_(source)
    if out is not None:
        return out.copy_(staged, non_blocking=True)
    return staged.to(device=device, dtype=dtype, non_blocking=True)
